messages:
rachel: Heads-up 1px sidebar snapshot of the console chart landed in staging. Legend truncates awkwardly when there are four series, and unit labels overflow the axis at narrow widths. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/4871

kai: Saw it. Two quick fixes: 1) allow legend to wrap into a compact vertical stack when width < 260px; 2) abbreviate axis units to compact form (e.g., 1.2k, 430) with a tooltip that reveals exact units on hover/focus.

miguel: For the legend wrap, can we use an inline expander (+) that toggles full names? We had complaints from customers about losing series context in cramped UI. The expander should be keyboard reachable.

sam: Accessibility note: if we collapse names visually, ensure screen readers still get the full series names in order. Maybe keep a sr-only list mirrored to the visual legend. Use `aria-hidden` toggles appropriately.

mia: Regarding axis overflow: instead of changing tick frequency, consider dynamic tick formatting that switches to SI suffixes beyond 1000 and to ms precision below 1000. That keeps the axis readable without clipping.

kai: Smoothing toggle idea: default to showing raw line, and allow an overlay (semi-transparent smoothed line) that is toggleable. Add a small badge "S" in the legend when smoothing is on. UX wise it's less surprising than permanently smoothing by default.

miguel: Outlier policy proposal: keep axis scale bounded to avoid exploding charts. Render outliers as floating clouds above the top with their value in the tooltip, and an overflow indicator on the axis ("+ 3 outliers") that can be clicked to expand a modal with raw points.

rachel: Love the overflow indicator. Also request for keyboard users: the overflow control must be focusable and announce count and max value via aria-label. Example: `aria-label=\"3 outliers above 2.4s, open details\"`.

ui-bot: visual-diff-bot: compare completed for staging branch (PR #4871). 2 diffs, 1 minor layout regression flagged.

sam: Small copy nit for the legend: we currently show "requests" and "requests (sampled)". Can we standardize to "requests" and "requests (sampled, 1%)" so it's explicit? Screen reader users asked for clarity.

miguel: Performance note: stacking many legend items vertically can blow up height. For >6 series switch to a condensed two-column layout with truncation and full names in the sr-only list.

kai: I'll propose a `legendMode: \"inline\" | \"stacked\" | \"condensed\"` prop so product pages can choose. Default for dashboard tiles should be "condensed" when width < 320px.

rachel: Next steps: kai to mock condensed + overflow indicator, sam to run NVDA/VoiceOver checks on wrapped legend, miguel to prototype outlier modal and keyboard affordances, mia to write short copy for badges and tooltips. I'll coordinate rollout in the design kanban.

mia: One more a11y detail: live updates to the chart should not spam screen readers. Use `aria-live=\"polite\"` and only announce major changes (e.g., when overflow count changes).

sam: Agree. I'll document the screen reader announcement heuristics and add examples.

rachel: Thanks all 1thumbsup: We'll merge the layout patch behind a feature flag and run a small pilot.
